search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 是连续函数，$D:x+y\leq1,x\geq0,y\geq0$，则二重积分 $\iint_Df(x,y)dxdy$ 可化累次积分为[\quad] $\int_0^1dx\int_1^{1+x}f(x,y)dy$ $\int_0^1dx\int_{-x}^1f(x,y)dy$ $\int_0^1dy\int_0^{1-y}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^1dy\int_{-y}^1f(x,y)dx$ 解答　原式$=\int_0^1dy\int_0^{1-y}f(x,y)dx$，原式$=\int_0^1dx\int_0^{1-x}f(x,y)dy$。
